What we build

Ongoing care for your software

Regular maintenance prevents small issues from becoming expensive problems, and keeps your software aligned with how your business works today.

Bug fixes

Investigating and resolving errors so your software behaves as expected.

Security updates

Applying updates and patches to reduce exposure to known vulnerabilities.

Performance optimization

Finding and fixing slow pages, queries and processes.

Feature improvements

Adding and refining features as your needs and users change.

Monitoring

Keeping an eye on availability and errors so issues are noticed early.

Technical support

A responsive technical partner when your team has questions or problems.

Scaling

Preparing your systems for more users, more data and new locations.

System updates

Keeping frameworks, dependencies and hosting environments current.

Our approach

Reliable support from a team that understands software

We support software we have built and can take over existing systems built by others. For an existing system, we start with a review to understand how it works and where the risks are.

Maintenance often reveals opportunities to improve. When it does, we can plan enhancements through custom software development or automation.

System review
An initial assessment of code, hosting, security and known issues.
Agreed scope
Clear arrangements for what is covered and how requests are handled.
Tested changes
Changes are tested before they reach your live system.
Documentation
Changes recorded so knowledge stays with your business.
Security first
Updates and access managed carefully to protect your data.
Clear communication
You know what was done, why, and what is recommended next.

Is it the right fit?

When you need maintenance and support

If your software is important to daily operations, it deserves regular care — not just attention when something breaks.

  • Your website or system has errors that have not been fixed
  • The original developer is no longer available
  • Software has not been updated in a long time
  • Pages or processes have become noticeably slow
  • You want to add features to an existing system without starting over
Ask about supporting your software

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Can you maintain software built by another developer?

Yes. We begin with a review of the existing code and setup, then agree what can be supported and recommend any improvements needed to keep it stable.

What does a maintenance arrangement include?

It depends on your system and needs. Typical arrangements cover updates, bug fixes, monitoring and an agreed amount of time for improvements. We define the scope together.

Do you support websites as well as business systems?

Yes. We maintain websites, mobile apps and custom business systems.

How do we request support?

You can reach us by phone, WhatsApp or email. Requests are logged and prioritized according to their impact on your business.
